title: UX Designer Career Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to solidify core UX fundamentals, build a showcase portfolio, and launch into professional work. Focuses on practical tasks, real‑world projects, and job‑ready preparation.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Lay the essential theoretical base and tool fluency.

milestones.title: User Research Foundations
milestones.outcome: Can plan and conduct basic qualitative research studies.

tasks.title: Read Nielsen Norman Group articles on user research
tasks.description: Study the key concepts of interviews, surveys, and contextual inquiry on NN/g’s free articles.

tasks.title: Watch freeCodeCamp UX research video series
tasks.description: Follow the playlist to understand research methods and when to apply them.

tasks.title: Create a research plan template
tasks.description: Draft a one‑page plan outlining objectives, participants, methods, and timeline.

tasks.title: Conduct a 5‑minute hallway interview
tasks.description: Practice asking open‑ended questions with a friend and record notes.

tasks.title: Reflect on interview findings
tasks.description: Write a brief summary of insights and how they shape design decisions.

milestones.title: Information Architecture Basics
milestones.outcome: Can organize content into clear structures and navigation schemes.

tasks.title: Read MDN guide on site structure and navigation
tasks.description: Focus on hierarchy, labeling, and breadcrumb concepts.

tasks.title: Sketch a sitemap for a favorite website
tasks.description: Map out main sections and subpages on paper or digital tool.

tasks.title: Create a card‑sorting test using OptimalSort free trial
tasks.description: Set up a simple open card sort with 10 items and run it with two participants.

tasks.title: Analyze card‑sort results
tasks.description: Identify patterns and propose a revised navigation hierarchy.

tasks.title: Share IA draft for critique on a design forum
tasks.description: Post the sitemap and ask for feedback, noting suggestions.

milestones.title: Figma Tool Mastery
milestones.outcome: Can efficiently prototype UI elements and create design specs.

tasks.title: Complete Figma free community onboarding tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the official tutorial to learn frames, components, and auto‑layout.

tasks.title: Recreate a login screen from an app
tasks.description: Build the UI using components and constraints to match the original design.

tasks.title: Set up a shared design system file
tasks.description: Create color styles, text styles, and component library for reuse.

tasks.title: Practice prototyping a simple flow
tasks.description: Link screens with interactions to simulate a user journey.

tasks.title: Give yourself a quick design critique
tasks.description: Evaluate the prototype against usability heuristics and note improvements.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop deeper design capabilities and testing proficiency.

milestones.title: Wireframing Techniques
milestones.outcome: Can produce low‑fidelity wireframes that communicate layout and flow.

tasks.title: Read UXPin guide on low‑fidelity wireframes
tasks.description: Understand when to use paper vs digital wireframes and common conventions.

tasks.title: Wireframe a checkout flow in Figma
tasks.description: Create 3‑4 screens using basic shapes and placeholders.

tasks.title: Iterate wireframe based on peer feedback
tasks.description: Share on a design community, collect comments, and refine the layout.

tasks.title: Compare paper vs digital wireframes
tasks.description: Sketch the same flow on paper, then replicate digitally; note pros and cons.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior UX mentor on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Ask for a quick review of your wireframes and request one tip.

milestones.title: Usability Testing Basics
milestones.outcome: Can plan, run, and synthesize simple usability tests.

tasks.title: Watch Nielsen Norman Group video on usability testing
tasks.description: Focus on test planning, moderation, and analysis steps.

tasks.title: Write a test script for a login task
tasks.description: Define clear tasks, success criteria, and prompts for participants.

tasks.title: Recruit 3 friends for a remote test
tasks.description: Schedule 30‑minute sessions using a free video tool and record screen.

tasks.title: Analyze recordings and extract pain points
tasks.description: Create a list of issues with severity ratings.

tasks.title: Present findings in a one‑page report
tasks.description: Summarize insights, recommendations, and next steps for stakeholders.

milestones.title: Design Critique Skills
milestones.outcome: Can give and receive constructive feedback effectively.

tasks.title: Read Google Design guide on critique culture
tasks.description: Learn the framework for framing feedback positively.

tasks.title: Join a free online design critique group
tasks.description: Participate in a live session, offering feedback on two peers’ work.

tasks.title: Write a critique of a popular app’s onboarding
tasks.description: Apply the framework to identify strengths and improvement areas.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback received
tasks.description: Note how critiques changed your perspective and future approach.

tasks.title: Connect with a local UX meetup
tasks.description: Attend a virtual meetup and share a short case study for group critique.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio‑ready case studies demonstrating end‑to‑end UX process.

milestones.title: App Redesign Case Study
milestones.outcome: A polished case study ready for portfolio inclusion.

tasks.title: Select an app you use daily
tasks.description: Choose one with clear usability issues to redesign.

tasks.title: Conduct 5‑minute user interviews
tasks.description: Gather pain points from two friends about the current app experience.

tasks.title: Create IA and wireframes in Figma
tasks.description: Map out new navigation and low‑fidelity screens.

tasks.title: Build a high‑fidelity prototype
tasks.description: Apply visual design, components, and interactions to showcase the redesign.

tasks.title: Write the case study narrative
tasks.description: Explain problem, research, design decisions, and outcomes in 800‑word format.

milestones.title: Usability Study Project
milestones.outcome: Demonstrates ability to run a full usability evaluation and iterate.

tasks.title: Define study goals and hypotheses
tasks.description: State what you aim to learn and expected outcomes.

tasks.title: Recruit 5 participants via social media
tasks.description: Use a short screener to ensure relevant user background.

tasks.title: Run remote moderated tests
tasks.description: Facilitate 30‑minute sessions, recording screen and audio.

tasks.title: Synthesize findings into affinity map
tasks.description: Group observations, identify themes, and prioritize issues.

tasks.title: Iterate design based on results
tasks.description: Update wireframes or prototype to address top pain points.

milestones.title: Onboarding Flow Prototype
milestones.outcome: Shows skill in crafting engaging first‑time user experiences.

tasks.title: Research onboarding best practices
tasks.description: Read articles from Smashing Magazine and UX Collective on effective onboarding.

tasks.title: Sketch user journey for first‑time use
tasks.description: Map steps from sign‑up to core value delivery.

tasks.title: Create low‑fidelity wireframes
tasks.description: Design each onboarding screen with placeholders.

tasks.title: Prototype interactive flow in Figma
tasks.description: Add transitions, micro‑interactions, and overlay explanations.

tasks.title: Conduct a quick 5‑person test
tasks.description: Observe users completing onboarding and note drop‑off points.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced expertise, job search tactics, and professional presence.

milestones.title: Advanced Interaction Design
milestones.outcome: Can design nuanced micro‑interactions and motion that enhance usability.

tasks.title: Explore Figma Community motion plugins
tasks.description: Install and experiment with a free motion library to add subtle animations.

tasks.title: Add micro‑interactions to onboarding prototype
tasks.description: Implement hover, tap, and transition effects using auto‑layout and prototyping tools.

tasks.title: Test interaction flow with a peer
tasks.description: Gather feedback on clarity and delight of the added motions.

tasks.title: Reflect on motion impact
tasks.description: Write a short note on how micro‑interactions affect user perception.

tasks.title: Share motion prototype on Dribbble
tasks.description: Post the interactive prototype and ask for community feedback.

milestones.title: Portfolio & Personal Brand
milestones.outcome: A compelling online presence that attracts recruiters or clients.

tasks.title: Create a personal website using Wix free plan
tasks.description: Build a simple site showcasing case studies, resume, and contact info.

tasks.title: Write an About Me page with design philosophy
tasks.description: Articulate your approach, values, and unique strengths in 300 words.

tasks.title: Gather feedback on portfolio from a senior designer
tasks.description: Send a link and request a detailed critique focusing on storytelling.

tasks.title: Update portfolio based on critique
tasks.description: Refine visuals, narratives, and navigation per feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on personal brand positioning
tasks.description: Summarize key messages you want employers to remember.

milestones.title: Job Search & Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Ready to apply for UX Designer roles and succeed in interviews.

tasks.title: Tailor resume for UX roles using a free template
tasks.description: Highlight key skills, projects, and measurable outcomes.

tasks.title: Apply to 5 targeted UX positions
tasks.description: Use job boards like Indeed and LinkedIn, customizing each cover letter.

tasks.title: Prepare answers to common UX interview questions
tasks.description: Write concise responses for research, design process, and critique scenarios.

tasks.title: Conduct a mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Role‑play interview, receive feedback on communication and storytelling.

tasks.title: Connect with recruiters on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Send personalized messages referencing shared interests or projects.
